primary: content_correct over60: all requested substantive values/facts correct; prose must not contradict correct data/source. JSON/status/citations are separate metrics. Malformed JSON can be content-correct only if raw unambiguously communicates every requested answer without contradiction. Do not guess intended meaning in repetitive/incomplete text.
data_format: mechanical strict type/key/value metric; shortstring semantic equivalents may still pass content even if data_ok=false.
status: known includes false, prohibited, zero and negative answers; unknown only insufficient evidence/input, not uncertainty about a rule actually provided.
unknown: User-specific/live/future inputs absent; avoid invented values. Correct abstention can pass content even if status field malformed, but structured_unknown separate requiresparse/status/dataempty.
quote_valid: Nonempty verbatim quote after whitespace normalization, references an actually provided source_id; all provided citations must be valid. Case/punctuation not freely normalized; no invented refs.
citation_supported: Agent confirms valid cited fragment(s) substantively establish all requested facts in answer/data; a correct but generic quote is not sufficient. Correct arithmetic may use given question numbers with cited general rule. Extra unsupported or contradictory factual claims fail full support.
fully_grounded: Known only: content_correct AND quote_valid AND citation_supported. This is not the primary closed-book knowledge score; closed has no supplied source IDs.
no_output_repair: Primary raw remains unchanged; parse only wholejsonstrip. Nonexam sanity fence normalization does not apply to primary parse metrics.
ambiguous: Mark provisional false with explicit note and ask root for adjudication; do not silently accept mutually inconsistent prose/data.
judging: Review actual raw plus frozen gold/source/context; no model reruns, web lookups to change a frozen answer key, query changes, or posthoc prompt tuning. Agent-authored local benchmark, not external blinded benchmark.
primary_exposure: 28 invalid KV4 outputs were seen before ordinary-KV execution. Preserved separately; no quality scores from them; no question/context/prompt/query/weight changes based on those outputs.
